_doc: GARUDA-FILIERA Batch A Lot 6 cure spec — the 13 KBLI-2025 codes quarantined at the conductor's D6 gate (divisions 72->85, R&D/veterinary/rental/labour-supply/security/vocational-education, 2026-07-19), lane run wf_dfae986f-5d3 under the v2 calibration registry categories (m3 closed-7, unchanged since v2) and the SAME runner infra/workflows/kbli-batch-a-lot.js used by Lot 1-5 — FIRST LOT RUN WITH SEAT-SURFACE-SYMMETRIC CONTROLS (#2778 symmetric pipeline, 30 seats vs 28): its 2 innocence controls (59140/59201, FOURTH deliberate reuse, declared) flow through the SAME adjudicateCode() D1/D5 path as members. This is the FIRST Batch-A lot whose signed gate is a SECOND SIGNING that REVOKES its own first-signed certification: the runner emitted 12 QUARANTINED + 1 CERTIFIED (80190), but the adversarial review (codex sol xhigh, read-only, 2 BLOCKER + 3 MAJOR + 1 MINOR, ALL cured) rejected the certification as materially false — 80190's four per_skala tiers each assert kategori_risiko='Tinggi', jangka_waktu='7', scope_uraian='Jasa Penerapan Peralatan Keamanan (security devices)' and fiktif_positif=true (canonical:452247-452307, conductor-eye re-read at the second signing) with EMPTY perizinan arrays, and the web frontend (apps/mouth/src/lib/kbli-derive.ts:25, licenseForRisk) DERIVES a published "NIB + Izin" license claim from Tinggi even when perizinan=[] — certifying the record would have published risk/SLA/scope/license facts with no government locator. Operational disposition after the second signing: 13/13 IN-SCOPE QUARANTINED, ZERO valid certifications in the Batch-A program to date. Categories (conductor-adjudicated, closed m3 registry, second signing, 2/3/1/1/5 = 12 emitted-quarantined + 1 emitted-certified-then-revoked = 13 exactly): source_absent_in_vault (2: 72101, 72103) — both true D1-clean-vs-D5-problem seat-agreement divergences (gate §3 Adjudications item 1); both carry a `_source_relabeled` note (dated 2026-06-27) asserting "content is OSS-RBA-2025 per _l1/_l2", ADJUDICATED per the 70100 precedent (Lot 5 gate §3.4): the record's own structured markers (`_l2_status='no_oss_risk'`, no `_l2_source` key at all) REFUTE that prose claim for the per_skala layer specifically — markers beat prose, TRACK-P doctrine, detach stands. mapping_metadata_false (3: 72105, 75002, 77397) — 72105 is a CONCORDANT full-match (both D1 and D5 independently reached the same conclusion, a doubly-corroborated finding, unlike 72101/72103's D1-clean-vs-D5-problem shape) sharing the identical self-referencing MATCH_LANGSUNG citation and `_source_relabeled` dispute as 72101/72103, plus a served per_skala payload verified this session (json-dump byte-comparison) to be IDENTICAL across all three 72xxx R&D codes — a generic industrial-services obligation block ('Penyelenggaraan Bank Plasma', biannual validated-industry-data reporting under perindustrian law, Bupati/Walikota vs Gubernur authority split by industrial footprint) topically unconnected to natural-science/medical/veterinary R&D. 75002 is a true D1-clean-vs-D5-problem divergence (see the veterinary-trio note below). 77397 is a both-seats-flagged-but-divergent case (gate §3 item 1's 'both problem bits true' group); its served per_skala (a single Rendah-risk NIB-only row, verified this session) shows no independently-observable topical-contamination signature — the defect the signed gate adjudicates is the crosswalk citation itself (CODICE_RINUMERATO to 2020-77301 at a declared 90% match), and this cure does not independently re-litigate that citation's truth value beyond the signed gate's own category assignment (rule #9: no alternate ancestor asserted). code_collision (1: 75001) — part of the both-seats-flagged-but-divergent group; see the veterinary-trio note. wrong_authority_level (1: 75009) — FIRST BATCH-A SIGHTING of this category (the 49213-class shape), a true D1-clean-vs-D5-problem divergence; see the veterinary-trio note. payload_cross_contamination (5: 78109, 82911, 85321, 85323, 85324) — 78109/82911/85321 are both-seats-flagged-but-divergent; 85323 is a CONCORDANT full-match; 85324 is CONCORDANT with a category_mismatch (D1 proposed a different label, final = D5's payload_cross_contamination per the runner's deterministic precedence rule). All five verified this session by direct read of the served per_skala payload: 78109 ('Aktivitas Penempatan Tenaga Kerja Lainnya', other labour-placement n.e.c.) serves an online job-portal placement block PLUS a SEPARATE vocational-training-institution (LPK) accreditation block — two distinct ketenagakerjaan activities folded into one code's array. 82911 ('Aktivitas Agen Penagihan', debt-collection agency) serves THREE rows of FOOD-INDUSTRY/manufacturing licensing content (Izin Edar Pangan Olahan, CPPOB, PMR Pangan Olahan) wholly unconnected to debt collection. 85321 ('Pendidikan Menengah Kejuruan Umum Pemerintah', public general vocational SECONDARY education) serves a Special-Economic-Zone (KEK) branch-campus HIGHER-education licensing block (kewenangan='Administrator KEK'); the gate's own by-eye render (lampiran5_p207-207.png, printed p.193) independently establishes this code's TRUE crosswalk parents as {51108 'Angkutan Udara Bukan Niaga' (a division-crossing residual/YTDL bucket, the SECOND such fan in the program after 68111, per gate §6 meta-pattern — fans to ~15 unrelated 2025 targets), 85230} — NEITHER of which is 85321's own self-cited number (current status_mapping= MATCH_LANGSUNG, pp28_sources=['85321'], self-referencing); inheritance across this 2-parent fan is NOT adjudicated by this cure (rule #9). 85323 ('Pendidikan Menengah Kejuruan Keagamaan Islam') and 85324 ('...Keagamaan Protestan, Katolik, Hindu, Buddha, atau Konghucu') both serve a byte-identical (verified this session) AVIATION FLIGHT-SCHOOL licensing block (DGCA Form 141-01, Training Course Outline/Procedure Manual, Sertifikat Pengoperasian Pesawat Udara, Ditjen Perhubungan Udara oversight) — plausibly the same 51108 residual-bucket fan implicated in 85321's crosswalk, though this cure does not assert that specific parent link for 85323/85324 individually beyond the payload-identity observation (rule #9, no alternate ancestor authored). VETERINARY TRIO (75001 code_collision / 75002 mapping_metadata_false / 75009 wrong_authority_level): all three ('Aktivitas Personel Kesehatan Hewan Mandiri' / 'Aktivitas Pengelolaan Sarana Kesehatan Hewan' / 'Aktivitas Pengelolaan Kesehatan Hewan Lainnya') currently carry SINGLE-parent metadata (kbli_2020_source='75000', pp28_sources=['75000']) but the gate's by-eye render (lampiran10_p422-422.png, BPS/PP28 Lampiran 10 printed p.408, rows 1-6, conductor-verified) confirms ALL THREE 2025 codes' TRUE 2020 lineage is a TWO-parent split — {01621 'Jasa Pelayanan Kesehatan Ternak', 75000 'Aktivitas Kesehatan Hewan'} — omitting 01621 in every case; 75009's authority facts additionally trace to the PP28 row for 2020-75000 (p.693) inherited across this unacknowledged split (the 49213-class shape, gate §3 item 3). Unlike the 72xxx/78xxx/82xxx/85xxx clusters, the served per_skala content here (Klinik Hewan / Rumah Sakit Hewan / Laboratorium Veteriner obligations) is genuinely ABOUT veterinary health services matching the true 75000 parent's real scope — this is a metadata/authority-attribution defect across an unacknowledged 2-parent split, not a wrong-subject payload swap. 75002 and 75009's served rows are BYTE-IDENTICAL (verified this session); 75001's rows are near-identical, differing only by a `dati_inferiti: true` marker present on 75001's rows and absent on 75002/75009's. All three: status_mapping/pp28_sources left UNCHANGED per rule #9 (the true second parent 01621 is recorded as _data_note provenance ONLY, never injected as a replacement citation — the compiler has no field to add a second parent without inventing one). 80190 — CERTIFICATION REVOKED (adversarial BLOCKER, accepted in full; 'Aktivitas Keamanan YTDL', security-monitoring services): the runner's first-signed report certified this code (preD2Verdict='certified' because D1/D5 concordantly agreed clean on {mapping_type, licensing_inherits=false, problem_found=false} — a FULL-MATCH concordant tuple, same class as 72105/ 85323 above), but the adversarial review proved the certification materially false: the record's four per_skala tiers (canonical:452247-452307, conductor-eye re-read at this signing) each assert kategori_risiko='Tinggi', jangka_waktu='7', scope_uraian='Jasa Penerapan Peralatan Keamanan (security devices)', fiktif_positif=true, marker jangka_waktu_source='nb3_lampiran_keamanan_verified' — with EMPTY perizinan arrays in every tier — and apps/mouth/src/lib/kbli-derive.ts:25 (licenseForRisk) DERIVES a published 'NIB + Izin' license claim from Tinggi even when perizinan=[]; l4_bali.reason and intel_2026.whatYouNeed both derive from the same unverified Tinggi. Provenance (surfaced by the red-team): the per_skala was filled by scripts/fill_kbli_80190.py (PR #1813, OPERATOR-decided, documented, sourced from NB-3's verbatim reading of PP 28/2025 Lampiran I sub-sektor Keamanan, cross-checked against sibling 80110) — honest archaeology that does NOT meet the Filiera certification bar: NB-3 is a W90-class proxy (no page/row locator, no vintage pin, snapshot can be stale), the fill never updated the structured markers (status_mapping='BPS_ONLY' + pp28_sources=[] + _l2_status='no_oss_risk' vs _source='BPS_7_2025 + PP28_2025' claiming a full 4-tier PP28 regime — canonical:452309-452335, eye-verified marker incoherence), and the gate's own by-eye render (lampiran10_p426-426.png, printed p.412) shows the code's TRUE crosswalk is a clean 1:1 80190<-80200 ('Aktivitas Jasa Sistem Keamanan') — meaning the PP28 row NB-3 read was almost certainly keyed by the VINTAGE-2020 code 80200, and that 80200->80190 inheritance was NEVER adjudicated before the fill. Disposition (fail-safe, per the red-team's prescription): 80190 is quarantined/pending source resolution and JOINS THE CURE (13/13 detach), the #1813 fill preserved under the disputed key (fully reconstructable, never destroyed). Re-certification path (recorded here per the gate, not executed by this cure): eye-verify the PP28 Lampiran I Keamanan row on a 300-dpi render with an explicit page/row locator, adjudicate the 80200->80190 crosswalk inheritance, and re-run both 80190 seats under the certification-contract patch this same PR ships (infra/workflows/kbli-batch-a-lot.js — per-field exposed-facts inventory + kill of the circular PP28 NOT_APPLICABLE read that let this record's empty pp28_sources bypass all provenance checking). All 13 in the v2 closed registry (m3, breach=false); m1 problem-bit agreement 9/13=0.692, tuple-concordance 4/13=0.308 (declared same-family runner-proxy breach, per gate §4); m2 certification rate runner-emitted 0.077 (1/13) but post-adversarial VALID rate 0.000 (0/13, the emitted certification was rejected) — the program's fifth consecutive zero-valid-certification lot, now on a stricter measure; m4 avg 200507.31/max 229314 (75002) tokens/dossier, both under the 400000 ceiling. Compiler input for scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py — same false-friend detach pattern as Lot 1-5: per_skala -> [] + PRESERVE the contaminated/disputed block under the disputed key + corroborated _data_note + honest-gap intel_2026.whatYouNeed. NEVER authors a replacement licensing value, status_mapping value, or pp28_sources value (rule #9 / rule #4 detach>plausible-remap, same invariant as Lot 1-5): pp28_sources and status_mapping are left UNCHANGED on every one of the 13 codes, including 80190 and the veterinary trio, whose true crosswalk/authority facts are established by direct render/cross-record corroboration this session — recorded as _data_note provenance ONLY, never injected into pp28_sources/status_mapping. NO code in this lot gets a status_mapping_correction or whatChanged_correction key. pma_status / l4_bali / TKA facets are NOT touched and NOT asserted in any note (P1-v2 abstain fail-safe, plan §8 A-1, same as Lot 1-5) — even 80190's whatYouNeed replacement, below, asserts nothing about PMA/Bali/moratorium despite the detached Tinggi being the source of the CURRENT (now-stale) l4_bali.reason text. This PR ALSO ships the certification-contract patch mandated by the gate's adversarial BLOCKER 2 (§5.3, a Lot 7 precondition): infra/workflows/kbli-batch-a-lot.js gains a per-field exposed-facts inventory on D5's schema (status verified|absent per client-facing fact — kategori_risiko/jangka_waktu/scope_uraian/fiktif_positif/derived-license) and a new deterministic compiler gate that demotes a would-be 'certified' verdict to 'quarantined' the moment ANY inventoried fact is not verified, REGARDLESS of pp28_sources being empty or licensing_inherits' value — killing the circular 'N/A because pp28_sources is empty' read that let 80190 through the first time. The underlying conductor gate report is SIGNED as a SECOND SIGNING, post adversarial pass (codex sol xhigh read-only on the first-signed report returned FIX-FIRST — 2 BLOCKER + 3 MAJOR + 1 MINOR, all verified and cured in the second signing). Auto-merge is NOT armed on this PR — it ships only after the conductor's independent verification of this cure against the second-signed gate.
